name: Tag
summary: A short label in a pill; removable with a named button inside it.

guidance.useFor: Short labels on items: a category, a status, a topic; and selected filters people can remove.
insteadUse: Filters that toggle on and off: Toggle button
content: Status tags carry a word, never colour alone

rungReason: A <span> for the label; removing is a native <button> with its own name.

a11y.role: none for the label; button for remove
a11y.name: The tag's text; the remove button's aria-label names the tag

rules: After removing, move focus to something sensible (the next tag, or the list's heading): the button is gone
For filters that toggle, use Toggle button: a tag is a label
withoutJavaScript: The label works; removing needs a form or a link instead
